name: Video facade + trust cards

clickToPlay.note: HARD CONSTRAINT, LOCKED TRUE. The original ships 0 iframes, 0 <video> elements and 0 third-party requests on load. The iframe is injected only after a user click. A generated instance must never autoplay or embed on load.

title.note: accessible label for the play button and the injected iframe

constraints.singleSection: /trust-safety's whole main is ONE section: the video block plus the 4 cards. It has no tabs, no CTA card, no testimonials slider and no Common questions (0 .swiper, 0 .w-dyn-empty).

motion.note: No entrance or scroll animation. Global .btn hover transitions only.

responsive.desktop: 2 rows of 2 cards (col-lg-5), not one 4-up wrap. Video box is .u-aspect-9x16 with an inline padding-top of 56.27659574468085%. Section 2096px tall.
responsive.le991: cards go col-md-6; card padding 2em, gap 2em, min-height auto.
responsive.le767: cards go col-sm-12 -> 1-up; video radius drops to 16px.

notes: The iframe interior was explicitly not measurable; only the outer box is spec-exact.
One icon carries width="96" as an HTML attribute, so it renders narrower than the 104px CSS cap — a direct consequence of preflight being disabled.
